- The level is chosen per feature at creation, declared in spec.md; risk growing mid-flight promotes — never stretch. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Declare Critical for domain invariants, irreversible data operations, authn/authz/payment, or auditor-facing evidence. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- spec.md answers the four Critical triggers in a Level Rationale; a sub-Critical Territory on a declared surface fails. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 1: the rollback plan is filled before phase 1 begins, not at review time. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 2: AI and human reviews each pass over the domain-invariants pack item by item, recorded. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 3: audit evidence retained — gate command + exit code, scope-check verdict, diff stat, both review checklists. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 4: human-executed gates only, one per phase — never agent-run gates, batching, ci-held, or the Micro lane. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5 (team): the Reviewer must have pulled the review; an owner's claim does not count. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: a Merge Readiness pending beside a tasks.md with every task ticked is graded as ready. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: ticks are a proxy; an unticked, absent or hidden task leaves Merge Readiness pending a claim. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: the human reviewer is never the owner; solo devs substitute a second-model review + 24h cooling-off. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- kit-adoption.json developers picks Critical 5's arm: none or one = solo substitute, 2+ = independent human review. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5 team arm: the Reviewer must be on the roster and permitted; membership catches a stranger, not identity. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: the artifact is a WARN until the final phase lands, it is committed or the plan says ready; then FAIL. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: when mid-feature cannot be shown (no base, shallow clone, bad tasks.md) the check stays strict and says why. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: plan.md may declare Merge Readiness pending or ready, overriding the heuristic; no history needed. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: Merge Readiness pending is a claim, not proof; changing it is an amendment, also inside a merge. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical 5: a merge is graded for what it authored; taking one parent's plan whole is trusted on that parent. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
- Critical adds nothing beyond the five items — protection comes from evidence and independence, not volume. (`docs/sdlc/critical-delivery.md`)
